act.long_title: An Act to provide a general Penal Code for India.

section.heading: Abetment of assault by soldier, sailor or airman on his superior officer, when in execution of his office
section.html: Whoever abets an assault by an officer, soldier, [sailor or airman], in the Army, [Navy or Air Force] of the [Government of India], on any superior officer being in the execution of his office, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, and shall also be liable to fine.
